name: conversation-history
description: Saves every user request and assistant response to ~/.claude/conversation-history/<repo>/<session>/

max_entries.title: How many messages to keep in the full history
max_entries.description: full.html keeps this many messages. When a new one comes in past the limit, the oldest is deleted. Default: 500.

first_entries.title: How many messages to save from the start of a session
first_entries.description: The first messages of a session are saved in first-N.md and never deleted. After compaction, they are used to recall the original goal. Default: 10.

last_entries.title: How many recent messages to save
last_entries.description: The most recent messages are saved in last-N.md. Each new message pushes out the oldest. After compaction, they are used to recall the latest work. Default: 10.
